items.statement: The investigation proposes chemically distinct coupling hypotheses and records candidate identity, deduplication/selection rationale, and coverage.
items.expected: At least one explicit hypothesis and per-candidate provenance/selection context are reported; bounded failure is acceptable if search diagnostics are complete.

items.statement: Retained minima and transition states are validated with frequency and connection evidence.
items.expected: Minima have no imaginary frequencies and a retained TS has one relevant imaginary mode plus IRC or justified equivalent connection evidence.

items.statement: The independently selected validated coupling endpoint has an activation free energy close to the paper's reported value.
items.expected: Activation free energy near 13.35 kcal/mol when a validated TS is obtained.

items.statement: The supplied azo product endpoint is thermodynamically favored for the coupling step.
items.expected: Reaction free energy near −29.58 kcal/mol when the endpoint is successfully computed.
